column1: # land_checks.tsv -- THE CHECKS A LANDING RUNS FOR THE PATHS IT TOUCHES (the cio 2026-11-16, on the cto's ask carried by officer_07; read by s4e_land.sh, checks_run; skill fleet-bus section 7).
# A check here is a script that holds one law of a tree and is neither a container entry (a shape) nor a registered generated table (generated_tables.tsv, which a landing regenerates itself).
# One row a check, four cells split by a tab. name: the stage reads LAND stage=check:<name>. paths: an extended regular expression read against each file the landing's own commits
# change, spelled repo/path (SCRIP/..., harness/..., corpus/..., .github/...); a landing that changes no such file never runs the row. check: a command run by bash in the landing's
# home with S4E_HOME, S4E_SCRIP and S4E_HARNESS naming the landing's own tree; rc 0 passes, rc 1 is LAND RED stage=check, rc 2 is LAND REFUSE(2), nothing pushed. cure: the words a
# red reading ends with. The check runs before the gate and again after every rebase the landing pushes from. The owner of a law adds its row; s4e_land.sh --probe-checks is the proof.
# A SHAPE OF A LAYER (skill fleet-bus section 7: a container entry whose family names a layer's law) is a row too: paths the layer's files, check the harness's own smoke verb grading
# the shape's entries in mode 3 on the landing's tree (corpus_suite_harness.py smoke --modes m3 --tables tests/LANG --entries ENTRY FEATURE, FEATURE a column the entry carries a 1 in).

column4: SCRIP src/runtime/xwin is generated, never edited (skill icon reference.md section 9): a change is made in the generator, the class table or the patch under harness designs/icon_xwin and reaches origin first, as a patch through the grader; then the tree is written again with util_gen_icon_xwin_device.py --out SCRIP/src/runtime/xwin and this landing vendors the tree that origin's generator writes

a shape of this layer reads red on the landing's own tree (skill fleet-bus section 7, A layer's shapes are run at its landing): the landing breaks the law the entry holds; run the row's check from the root to reproduce, cure it, land again
